notes.title: 2024-06-27 Update - Version 1.2.0 and new DLC!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Today, we'd like to share update 1.2.0 for CRYMACHINA with the following bug fixes:


 Fixed the new Head and Waist Personality Enhancement Gears displaying incorrect icons under certain conditions.
 Fixed Archive entry for Server Farm Patience having an incorrect network listed.
 Fixed Frontier Fort: Extreme stage keeping the New label even after clearing it.

Please report issues you may have to the Steam troubleshooting forum.


Additionally, the following two new DLCs are now available.

CRYMACHINA - Standard Uniform Set
CRYMACHINA - Trinity Set (Three additional playable characters)

Customers who already own other DLCs can save by purchasing one of the following two bundles to complete the contents.

CRYMACHINA - Complete Costumes (June 2024 Update)
CRYMACHINA Ultimate Edition (June 2024 Update)


Thank you for playing!

notes.title: 2023-11-18 Update - Version 1.0.8
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Today, we'd like to share update 1.0.8 for CRYMACHINA with the following changes:


 New items added.
 Stability and minor bug fixes.
 Minor text fixes.
 PC specific: Fixed issue that prevented players from selecting Auxiliaries to dismantle when using the keyboard.

Please report issues you may have to the Steam troubleshooting forum.

Thank you for playing!
